name: RescueNYC
neighborhoods: NYC citywide; TNR recovery/holding space + caretaker guidance
notes:
Community Cat Program provides pre/post spay-neuter holding, minor-medical holding, and support for caretakers doing large-scale TNR (removes the holding-space barrier). Support resource for caretakers, incl. Brooklyn. Email confirmed on own site. Intake: Email Info@rescuenyc.org for community-cat guidance / TNR recovery program

501(c)(3) NYC foster-based rescue and approved ACC rescue partner. Pulls at-risk animals from the NYC shelter system into foster homes for rehoming. Foster-based, no facility.
